Question 8
?

Which of the following is the correct symbolic notation for the sentence given below?

"The function f maps the interval from −1 to 1 exclusive to the set Y."

a
f:{−1,1}→Y
b
f:(−1,1)→Y
c
f:[−1,1]→Y
d
f:Y→(−1,1)
e
f:Y→{−1,1}
